minimum_action: establish one unambiguous structural level crosswalk between known G3 datum and V_ORDER/upper-floor datum using documentary section plus direct level measurement or equivalent reliable survey
acceptance_output: versioned level table with datum definition and measured vertical differences; explicit mapping to structural G4/V_ORDER terminology
notes: Do not infer 3.20 m to G4. Preserve distinction between architectural finished surfaces and structural axes.

minimum_action: measure/check structural-axis relative heights at representative eave and ridge locations for each of the three roof fields
acceptance_output: per-field eave/ridge structural-axis Z relative to V_ORDER datum with measurement uncertainty
notes: Historical 2.4/3.4 m values remain scenario/reference until axis-to-axis measurement is reconciled.

minimum_action: recover existing geotechnical report if available; otherwise obtain engineering geotechnical characterization sufficient to select a documented analytical boundary model
acceptance_output: versioned foundation-boundary decision: fixed/spring/other with parameters, provenance and sensitivity range
notes: No fixed-base default. Foundation geometry already exists separately; this task addresses soil-structure boundary behavior.

minimum_action: qualified material characterization campaign; use existing sclerometer only as part of an evidence-controlled programme and calibrate/augment as required by the responsible engineer/lab
acceptance_output: accepted concrete mechanical parameter set with test locations, statistics, uncertainty and mapping to structural zones
notes: Do not derive canonical E from an uncalibrated sclerometer reading alone.

minimum_action: recover original steel specification/certificates if available or perform engineering identification/testing as required
acceptance_output: steel elastic/material parameter set with source and confidence
notes: Scenario E may be used for sensitivity only, not canonical promotion.

minimum_action: measure J1-J2 member section in current state and document distal support J2 plus any visible connection/support geometry
acceptance_output: section b×h; photographs/measurements of J2 support condition; update local terrace subgraph
notes: Receiver P08-P16 and J1 station are already source-bound; do not re-open them.

minimum_action: directly measure or obtain new documentary evidence for the seven priority ridge/eave members
acceptance_output: member-by-member b×h with endpoint identity and evidence photo/document reference
notes: No family inheritance unless equality is independently demonstrated.

minimum_action: directly measure or obtain new documentary evidence for remaining nine roof members
acceptance_output: member-by-member b×h with endpoint identity and evidence reference
notes: Current TAV-06A and v25 documentary sources are exhausted for these sections.

minimum_action: after FI-001/FI-003/FI-004/FI-006 and selected scenario/field closure of roof sections, regenerate M0 package and run solver preflight before any engineering analysis
acceptance_output: numeric preflight PASS plus explicit list of any remaining scenario-only parameters
notes: Assessment-grade analysis additionally requires engineering acceptance of evidence and modelling choices; numeric completeness alone is insufficient.

minimum_action: execute by evidence priority rather than by file order
acceptance_output: each completed task updates M0_NUMERIC_UNLOCK_MATRIX_v1.csv and the relevant canonical dataset before solver regeneration
notes: Residuals remain nonblocking outside their dependent outputs.
